description: Create ONE category, optionally under a parent category id (ids from get_item_requirements). For a whole tree prefer scaffold_categories — it previews, and it reuses existing nodes instead of duplicating. Not idempotent: a repeat creates a same-name sibling — after a timeout, check the category list before retrying. Requires the manager role.

parentId.description: Parent category id (omit for top level)

name: create_category
title: Create category
